about.title: About A.OULL
about.lead: A Newritage craft brand made in collaboration with master artisans of endangered Korean traditional crafts
about.section1Body: New and Heritage. We bring old skills out of the museum and into everyday life, remaking them as things you want to use today so the artisans' skills and stories can continue.
about.section2Body: Based on oral-history interviews, we recreate each artisan's voice with AI to create a docent. It is offered in Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese, with a QR code beside every work.
about.section3Body: After listening, you can book a workshop with the artisan or shop their work.
